test_kernel_pca_solvers: test the KernelPCA class with dense, arpack, and randomized eigen_solvers producing similar results
build_kernel_pca_pipeline: build a KernelPCA pipeline with GridSearchCV to tune gamma for RBF kernel on nested circles data
test_kernel_pca_precomputed: test KernelPCA with a precomputed kernel matrix and verify equivalence to built-in kernel computation
test_kernel_pca_inverse_transform: test KernelPCA with fit_inverse_transform for reconstructing original data from transformed components
test_kernel_pca_non_psd_kernel: test KernelPCA handling of non-positive-semidefinite precomputed kernel matrices with error raising
